# New-ZbxAction

## SYNOPSIS

Creates an action.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxAction [[-Name] <string>] [[-EventSource] <ZabbixEventSource>] [-Status <ZabbixActionStatus>] [-EscalationPeriod <string>] [-PauseSymptoms <bool>] [-PauseSuppressed <bool>] [-Filter <ZabbixActionFilterRequest>] [-Operation <ZabbixActionOperationRequest[]>] [-RecoveryOperation <ZabbixActionRecoveryOperationRequest[]>] [-UpdateOperation <ZabbixActionUpdateOperationRequest[]>] [-NotifyIfCanceled <bool>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

An action reacts to events: when its conditions match a trigger, discovery, autoregistration, internal or service event, it sends messages, runs scripts or changes hosts. The New-ZbxAction cmdlet sends action.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new action back with action.get and writes it. The server requires -Name and -EventSource; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create an action that notifies a user group about disasters

```powershell
$condition = New-ZbxActionCondition -ConditionType TriggerSeverity -Operator MoreEqual -Value 5
$notify = New-ZbxActionOperation -OperationType Message -OperationMessageGroup (Get-ZbxUserGroup -Name 'Operators') -OperationMessage @{ default_msg = 1 }
New-ZbxAction -Name 'Notify on disaster' -EventSource Triggers -Filter @{ evaltype = 'AndOr'; conditions = @($condition) } -Operation $notify |
    Select-Object ActionId, Name, EventSource, Status
```

A trigger action (-EventSource Triggers) with one condition and one message operation, built with New-ZbxActionCondition and New-ZbxActionOperation. The created action is read back and written to the pipeline.

### Example 2: Also notify when the problem is resolved, and start it disabled

```powershell
$condition = New-ZbxActionCondition -ConditionType TriggerSeverity -Operator MoreEqual -Value 5
$notify = New-ZbxActionOperation -OperationType Message -OperationMessageGroup (Get-ZbxUserGroup -Name 'Operators') -OperationMessage @{ default_msg = 1 }
New-ZbxAction -Name 'Notify and recover' -EventSource Triggers -Status Disabled -Filter @{ evaltype = 'AndOr'; conditions = @($condition) } -Operation $notify -RecoveryOperation @{ operationtype = 11; opmessage = @{ default_msg = 1 } } |
    Select-Object Name, Status
```

-RecoveryOperation runs when the problem closes (operationtype 11 = notify all involved); -Status Disabled creates the action without letting it fire until it is enabled with Set-ZbxAction.

### Example 3: Register Linux agents automatically

```powershell
$condition = New-ZbxActionCondition -ConditionType HostMetadata -Operator Like -Value 'Linux'
$operations = @(
    New-ZbxActionOperation -OperationType HostAdd
    New-ZbxActionOperation -OperationType GroupAdd -OperationGroup (Get-ZbxHostGroup -Name 'Linux servers')
    New-ZbxActionOperation -OperationType TemplateAdd -OperationTemplate (Get-ZbxTemplate -Name 'Web App')
)
New-ZbxAction -Name 'Register Linux agents' -EventSource Autoregistration -Filter @{ evaltype = 'AndOr'; conditions = @($condition) } -Operation $operations |
    Select-Object Name, EventSource
```

An autoregistration action: agents whose HostMetadata contains "Linux" are added as hosts, put into the 'Linux servers' group and linked to a template. -OperationGroup and -OperationTemplate take objects read with Get-Zbx*.

### Example 4: Preview the action without creating it

```powershell
New-ZbxAction -Name 'Notify on disaster' -EventSource Triggers -WhatIf
```

-WhatIf prints what New-ZbxAction would do and sends nothing (ConfirmImpact is Medium, so without -WhatIf or -Confirm it creates the action straight away).

## INPUTS

- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -EscalationPeriod (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixEventSource`: Bound to -EventSource (ByPropertyName). The event source values: EVENT_SOURCE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixActionStatus`: Bound to -Status (ByPropertyName). The action status values: ACTION_STATUS_* in defines.inc.php.
- `bool`: Bound to -PauseSymptoms (ByPropertyName), -PauseSuppressed (ByPropertyName), -NotifyIfCanceled (ByPropertyName). True or false.
- `ZabbixActionFilterRequest`: Bound to -Filter (ByPropertyName). filter of a ZabbixActionCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixActionOperationRequest[]`: Bound to -Operation (ByPropertyName). operations of a ZabbixActionCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixActionRecoveryOperationRequest[]`: Bound to -RecoveryOperation (ByPropertyName). recovery_operations of a ZabbixActionCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixActionUpdateOperationRequest[]`: Bound to -UpdateOperation (ByPropertyName). update_operations of a ZabbixActionCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.
